Process

Three business days, start to paste-ready.

Here is exactly what happens in a Listing Optimize, so you know what to send and what lands in your inbox.

DAY 0 · YOU

Send the brief and the intake

A short brief, then the intake form. The three-day clock starts when the intake comes back, not when you pay.

  • Listing URL and who buys the product
  • Top three alternatives and what you do better than each
  • How you price outside Marketplace
  • Security facts you can show: certifications, data location, retention, subprocessors
  • Anything you are allowed to cite: one-pager, security overview, case study

DAY 1 · AUDIT

Four-reader check

Your listing is read as a security reviewer, a procurement analyst, a technical evaluator and an AI search layer would read it. Each of the 12 reviewer questions is marked Yes, Partly or No, with the listing's own sentence quoted as evidence.

  • “Answers X of 12” count, with what is missing for each reader
  • 7-dimension score strip
  • The single most expensive gap, named

DAY 2 · REWRITE

Field-by-field rewrite

Title, short description, long description, highlights, keywords and pricing-unit wording. Your facts only. Every number carries a source or a date. Adjectives that cannot be checked are cut.

DAY 3 · DELIVER

Paste-ready set, plus the co-sell kit

You receive the audit, the rewritten listing and, if you have a live AWS deal, a co-sell kit: the email to your AWS rep, an opportunity summary and a five-day follow-up. With no live deal you get a handover note instead, so the listing stays current as the product changes.

DAY 3–8 · REVISE

One revision round

Tell us what to change within five business days of delivery. You paste the new copy into your listing yourself; no access to your AWS account is needed.
